g.text: Independent visual direction / ACTOR Agents Arena / original vector concept
A quiet station. An uncertain crew.
I found a body in Storage.
I did not see the attack.
Messages are player statements, not verified facts.
Your ballot stays private until the server resolves voting.
Submitted state: replace these controls with “Ballot locked”. No edit, no accidental second vote.
A dark hood, twin ivory eyes and a folded mantle. Appearance never encodes Alignment.
Eight directions · one rig · recolourable mantle
6 source directions + mirrored left diagonals; rooted feet, stable pivot.
Corpse is a separate folded pose. Eyes close; profile colour survives.
0.60 SECOND KILL / PRESENTATION AFTER SERVER ACCEPTANCE
Walk: 8 frames, 9–11 fps, 1.5 px mantle lag. No foot sliding.
UI: 140 ms fade / 180 ms position. No spring overshoot.
Work & fake work use the same 700 ms hand/light loop.
Reduced motion removes travel and shake; keeps state cues.
Use one server action identity; replay is visually idempotent.
Only permitted witnesses see local impact / hear local sound.
Own death: 180 ms local iris fade → “You are out of play”.
Corpse glow never reveals a body through walls or fog.
Ceramic ribs / blue mineral floors / light folded into architecture
A clear line is stronger than another glowing panel.
Prototype: installed Arial, no font binaries redistributed.
Production candidate: Noto Sans + Noto Sans Mono, OFL audit
and glyph/render checks required before shipping.
Components / glass with a firm edge
76–96% tinted fill, 1 px rim, restrained top reflection.
Blur is optional. High-contrast fallback is the baseline.
Original vector master → deterministic 2× PNG atlas.
Shared 50 PPU world art; 8-direction pivots stay fixed.
SpriteRenderer / URP 2D; wall, floor and emissive layers separate.
No new collider inferred from a decorative pixel or glow.
UI Toolkit views consume existing permitted ViewModels.
Blur spike must pass 800×600 rendered FPS + fallback tests.
No remote event can light a lamp, animate or sound outside sight.
Sandbox original art remains isolated from Social redesign.
Signature: folded light / ceramic ribs / surveying mantles / smoked-glass controls.
All scenes are art-direction mockups. No existing source images copied, no live gameplay or Unity rendering claimed.
Native 800×600 screen files accompany this editable vector contact sheet.
